<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">TaxiOptions</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>All the options to specify how a taxi route should be calculated. See, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#TAXI"><code>TransportMode.TAXI</code></a>.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> Specify the optional <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-waypoint#sideOfStreetHint"><code>Waypoint.sideOfStreetHint</code></a> to indicate at which side of
 the street a passenger wants to leave the taxi.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a id="lastCharacterOfLicensePlate">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>lastCharacterOfLicensePlate</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.String lastCharacterOfLicensePlate</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies the last character of a vehicle's license plate, typically used to
 evaluate traffic restrictions in certain environmental or low-emission zones.
 In cities like Bogotá, Mexico City, or Jakarta, specific license plate digits may
 be restricted on certain days or in certain areas to reduce congestion and emissions.
 When this value is provided, the HERE SDK considers it during route calculation to
 avoid roads or areas where your vehicle may be restricted based on local regulations.
 Example usage: &quot;7&quot;, when the license plate of a vehicle looks like &quot;B-ET-182487&quot;.
 <p>If this value is not set, such license plate-based restrictions are ignored, and
 routing is performed without considering them.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="maxSpeedOnSegments">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>maxSpeedOnSegments</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-maxspeedonsegment" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">MaxSpeedOnSegment</a>&gt; maxSpeedOnSegments</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Segments with restriction on maximum <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-dynamicspeedinfo#baseSpeedInMetersPerSecond"><code>DynamicSpeedInfo.baseSpeedInMetersPerSecond</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="allowDriveThroughTaxiRoads">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>allowDriveThroughTaxiRoads</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;boolean allowDriveThroughTaxiRoads</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies if a vehicle is allowed to drive through the taxi-only roads and lanes.
 When set to <code>false</code>, it is still allowed on taxi roads after the route start and
 before the route destination.</div>
</li>
</ul>
